title: [Feature][Model] Support DeepSeek V4.1 Endoder SWA bounded replay
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Support DeepSeek V4.1 SWA bounded replay on Ascend, integrating the upstream replay mechanism from vllm-project/vllm#56227. After a prefix-cache hit, rebuild the sliding-window KV while preserving the shared cached KV of other cache groups. Supports both Ascend V1 and V2 model runners.

- Carry replay configuration and retained-token fields through Ascend cache construction and spec merging.
- Propagate replay starts for new and resumed requests, including serialization across the scheduler/worker boundary.
- Pad replayed slot mappings for prefix-cacheable groups so replay does not overwrite shared KV; V1 and V2 use their respective slot-mapping layouts.
- Clamp SWA attention to the replay start through per-token visible lengths in sparse flash MLA band mode, including arch22/arch35 kernels and host-side validation.
- Disable replay for unsupported scheduler modes and PCP configurations; retain compatibility with upstream versions without the replay fields.
- Add regression coverage for configuration fallback, cache specs, resumed-request metadata, slot padding, and attention visibility.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Supported DeepSeek V4.1 configurations can use upstream SWA bounded replay on Ascend with either runner. Unsupported scheduler configurations fall back to prefix-cacheable SWA behavior. No new environment variable is introduced.

### How was this patch tested?

- Existing PR validation: `git diff upstream/main...HEAD --check` and `python -m py_compile` for the original 16 changed Python files passed.
- Existing PR formatting attempt: `bash format.sh ci` could not complete because `pre-commit` is not installed.
- Existing targeted pytest attempt was blocked during conftest loading because the local vLLM checkout lacks `FP32ReplicatedLinear` imported by `patch_step3p5.py`. No unit-test pass is claimed.
- V2 follow-up: `git diff --check` and `python -m py_compile` passed for all three changed Python files.
- Current `bash format.sh ci` attempt is blocked because `pre-commit` is not installed.
- CANN/C++ kernel compilation, NPU execution, end-to-end accuracy, ACL Graph replay, and performance benchmarks have not been run in this macOS environment and still require validation.

The verified vLLM pin above predates vLLM #56227, so it does not provide scheduler replay-start metadata or the upstream bounded-replay switch. The V2 integration is wired for the API from #56227 and requires that API in the paired vLLM revision before runtime activation can be validated.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/ced6857afa0ea7b2e3f0846a62e1394e90f15607


Co-authored-by: dodatboii
